title: Freemans WBJ10 10"/250mm Alloy Steel Box Joint Water Pump Plier bundled with 12mm x 8m PTFE Teflon Thread Seal Tape & Wike Cleaning Cloth for Plumbing & Pipe
description: Get the ultimate plumbing and pipe fitting tool set with the WBJ10 Water Pump Plier Bundle. This kit includes a high-quality 10"/250mm alloy steel water pump plier, 12mm x 8m PTFE Teflon thread seal tape, and a premium wike cleaning cloth, providing everything you need for reliable, long-lasting results in your plumbing, automotive, and general repair tasks.Key Features:Heavy Duty Construction: Made from premium alloy steel, these water pump pliers are engineered to handle tough, heavy-duty tasks. They are built to withstand frequent use and last for years, ensuring reliability even in demanding jobs.Adjustable Jaws: The adjustable jaws of the pliers offer versatility, allowing you to set them to different widths to accommodate a wide range of sizes. Perfect for working with pipes, nuts, bolts, and other hardware during your plumbing or automotive projects.Versatile Functionality: With a 10" (250mm) length, these pliers are ideal for various plumbing, automotive, and repair tasks. Whether you’re working on water taps, pipes, or fittings, they offer excellent leverage and gripping power.Ergonomic Design: The pliers feature ergonomically designed contoured handles that offer a comfortable grip, reducing hand fatigue during extended use. This makes it easier to work on larger projects without discomfort.Epoxy Dip Sleeve: The epoxy-coated dip sleeve on the handles provides a non-slip, secure grip, even in wet or oily conditions. This ensures safety and precision when you need it most.Included Accessories:12mm x 8m PTFE Teflon Thread Seal Tape: A must-have for plumbing and pipe fittings, this high-quality Teflon tape creates a leak-proof seal to ensure optimal performance and reliability.Wike Cleaning Cloth: Keep your tools and workspace clean with the included cleaning cloth, ideal for wiping off grease, dirt, and debris from your tools and equipment after use.Whether you’re a professional plumber or a DIY enthusiast, this bundle has everything you need for your plumbing and pipe fitting projects. Enhance your efficiency and ensure long-lasting results with the WBJ10 Water Pump Plier Set.
